main.description: Returns an indexed work-scope tag and its hydrated publisher for an exact AT-URI; authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full work-scope-tag AT-URI using a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.name: WorkscopeTagQueryFailed
